price.src: User-provided share price ($541, 12-Oct-2026); update to market.

guidance_q1fy27.note: Q1 FY27 outlook given on the 29-Jul-2026 earnings call and re-filed (with mechanical adjustments to the FY27 two-segment structure) in the 8-K of 2-Sep-2026, Item 7.01, Ex. 99.1 "FY27 Segments and Investor Metrics" - SEC-filed, so verified on EDGAR.
guidance_q1fy27.cases: High / Mid / Low = Bull / Base / Bear; costs at the low end for Bull and the high end for Bear (cost ranges $29.6-29.8bn COGS, $16.8-16.9bn opex).

guidance_fy27_unverified.status: UNVERIFIED - not filed on EDGAR (earnings-call commentary, 29-Jul-2026, as reported by third parties)
guidance_fy27_unverified.text: FY27: double-digit revenue and operating income growth; continued growth in capital expenditures.

debt.note: Long-term debt at 30-Jun-2026: face value $46,136m, carrying value $40,294m (current $9,227m; long-term $31,067m); the difference is unamortized discount and fair-value adjustments (mainly the Activision Blizzard notes assumed in Oct-2023). Maturities (face): FY27 $9,250m, FY28 nil, FY29 $2,001m, FY30 nil, FY31 $500m, thereafter $34,385m. No commercial paper outstanding.
debt.fl_note: Finance leases (primarily datacenters): liabilities $66,594m at 30-Jun-2026 ($4,290m current, $62,304m in other long-term liabilities), weighted-average discount rate 4.5%, remaining term 13 years; right-of-use assets obtained $24,608m in FY26; principal repaid $3,101m; interest $2,547m. Leases signed but not yet commenced are disclosed separately in Note 14.

ppe.lives: Software 3 years; servers and network equipment 2-6 years; buildings and improvements 5-15 years; leasehold improvements 3-20 years; furniture 1-10 years.

buyback.note: $60bn program approved 16-Sep-2024 (no expiry); $40.6bn remaining at 30-Jun-2026. FY26 repurchases $16.7bn under the program plus $5.6bn withholding for employee tax.

dividend.note: Quarterly dividend $0.91 declared 10-Jun-2026 (paid 10-Sep-2026). Microsoft raises the quarterly dividend each September (FY25 $0.83 -> FY26 $0.91, +9.6%).

Q2-17.note: Total purchase price $27,009m less cash acquired $1,328m; short-term investments $2,110m and other current assets $697m in current assets; deferred taxes $774m and other $131m in noncurrent liabilities.

Q3-22.note: Final allocation (FY2024 10-K): goodwill $16,326m, intangibles $4,365m, other assets $42m, other liabilities $(1,972)m incl. $986m of convertible notes (substantially redeemed).

Q2-24.note: Total purchase price $75,408m less cash acquired $12,976m; other assets $2,501m; long-term debt $2,799m; long-term income taxes $1,914m + deferred taxes $4,677m (noncurrent); other liabilities $3,617m (shown as current).

Q1-26_cf.note: Q1 FY26 cash flow: the Q2 FY26 release six-month column reclassified $4,914m from "Depreciation, amortization, and other" to "Net recognized losses (gains) on investments and derivatives" (OpenAI equity-method results); CFO unchanged. Q1 is restated from the later year-to-date statement: D&A and other = H1 $17,345m - Q2 $9,198m = $8,147m (originally $13,061m); gains = $(1,007)m - $4,914m. Source: Q2 FY26 release (8-K 28-Jan-2026, Ex. 99.1).

exceptions.FY2016: Q1-Q3 FY16 as originally reported; the FY2016 10-K / Q4 release early-adopted ASU 2016-09 effective 1-Jul-2015 (excess tax benefits in the tax provision; cash-flow reclassification), so FY2016 tax, net income, CFO and CFF differ from the sum of the quarters by $302m.
exceptions.FY2008_OI: FY2008 operating income $22,492m as originally reported (FY2008 10-K); later 10-K comparatives (XBRL) show $22,271m. The model keeps the original.
exceptions.FY2006_07_cash: FY2006-07 10-K cash-flow statements present "Net change in cash and equivalents" before the effect of exchange rates.

useful_life: Q1 FY27 outlook: capital expenditures "expected to be over $50 billion including the impact of the useful life update" (8-K 2-Sep-2026). The update is not quantified in the filings reviewed.
